activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A bank quotes 3-month GBP forward at Bid 1.5736 and Offer 1.5742. ImportCo must pay £10 million in 3 months. Which rate does ImportCo pay, and what is the locked-in USD cost?
activeRecallQuiz.question: A bank quotes 3-month GBP forward at Bid 1.5736 and Offer 1.5742. ImportCo must pay £10 million in 3 months. Which rate does ImportCo pay, and what is the locked-in USD cost?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: ImportCo buys £10M at the bank's Offer Rate of 1.5742, locking in a total cost of $15,742,000 (while an exporter selling GBP gets the 1.5736 Bid Rate).
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
